jobs.job_description:
Backend Engineer

About Us:

PT DMC Indonesia is developing an industrial-scale Smart Greenhouse System integrating IoT (LoRaWAN), Node-RED, MQTT, Supabase PostgreSQL, and AI (LLM + CNN). This system will automate greenhouse devices, monitor real-time plant conditions, and generate AI-based recommendations.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to build the core technical backbone of this platform.

🎯 Job Description

The Backend Engineer will develop APIs, automation logic, device-control services, and AI integrations for our Smart Greenhouse platform.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and maintain REST / WebSocket APIs for real-time sensor ingestion, device control (fans, vents, pumps, valves) via MQTT or Router API, and AI integration (LLM reasoning)

- Integrate data flows from Node-RED → MQTT → Supabase PostgreSQL.

- Build backend services for device control, alert engine & automation logic, and event-driven actions

- Implement authentication, rate limiting, error handling, and secure API patterns.

- Create middleware enabling two-way communication between IoT hardware, backend server, and web dashboard

- Provide API documentation for the frontend & AI engineering teams.

- Debug end-to-end issues (IoT → Node-RED → Backend → DB → Dashboard).

- Collaborate with the Database Engineer for optimal schema and query performance.

📌 Qualifications

- 1–3 years experience as a Backend Engineer.

- Strong proficiency in Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), and Python (FastAPI / Flask)

- Good understanding of REST API & WebSocket, MQTT / event-driven systems, Docker & container workflows, and Git version control

- Experience integrating with PostgreSQL, Supabase, InfluxDB, or any similar database.

- Familiar with IoT integrations, Node-RED or Home Assistant.

- Knowledge of distributed systems or microservices.

- Experience integrating AI inference or LLM-based services.

- Clear communication with English and problem-solving mindset.

- Able to work independently in a small, fast-moving team.

- Strong ownership of assigned modules.

• Design and implement backend services, APIs, data models, integrations, and business logic.
• Build and maintain application features using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, SQL, and modern web/backend frameworks.
• Work with system and business analysts to turn workflows and requirements into technical designs.
• Participate in selected client discussions to clarify requirements, understand real operating workflows, support UAT, and explain technical behavior.
• - Read existing codebases and build an accurate model of how they actually work before changing them.
• Use coding agents to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, refactoring, investigation, and documentation.
• Break work into bounded, well-specified tasks that both humans and coding agents can execute reliably.
• Review AI-generated code critically rather than accepting it because it compiles or passes a superficial test.
• Design relational schemas, queries, indexes, constraints, and migrations.
• Build safe integrations between APIs, databases, files, third-party systems, and AI services.

Minimum Qualifications

• Roughly 1–3 years of software-development experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability
• Good programming fundamentals in at least one backend-capable language.
• Working understanding of SQL and relational databases.
• Ability to read unfamiliar code and reason about what it is doing.
• Ability to explain design choices rather than saying only that an approach “works.”
• Curiosity about trade-offs, failure modes, and architecture.
• Habit of testing and verifying your own assumptions.
• Comfort using AI coding tools, or strong willingness to adopt an agent-native way of working.
• Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, analysts, and occasionally client users.
• Strong learning velocity and willingness to enter unfamiliar domains.

About DOT Indonesia

DOT Indonesia has been delivering fully customized IT solutions since 2011, guided by our mission to create intelligent, competitive products that drive exceptional outcomes for our clients. Rooted in agile philosophy, we adapt and innovate to meet evolving business needs.

Over the years, we have successfully collaborated with several clients from different business sectors, such as mining & energy, finance, e-commerce, education, human resource, and government.

Our diverse team of strategists, designers, technologists, and creators work together to turn ideas into reality. Whether you're a thinker, explorer, maker, or creator, there’s a place for you at DOT Indonesia. Join us as a DOT Ranger and grow your career with our AHEAD (agile, harmony, excellent, altruistic, and driven) values!

Job Description

As an Agentic AI Developer, you will be responsible for developing GenAI-powered applications and integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise systems. You will work on building reliable AI-enabled applications while collaborating with engineering teams to integrate them into existing business environments.

Job Responsibilities

• Develop GenAI and agentic AI applications using Python or other relevant programming languages.

• Build and maintain software components supporting AI-powered applications.

• Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) with enterprise systems and applications.

• Develop APIs, services, and application workflows required for AI integration.

• Collaborate with engineering and other technical teams to implement GenAI solutions.

• Support testing, troubleshooting, and improvement of AI-powered applications.

Qualifications

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in software development/programming, preferably using Python or related technologies.

• Minimum 1 year of experience working on Generative AI projects.

• Hands-on experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with enterprise systems.

• Able to provide relevant project references demonstrating the required experience.

Role Purpose:

Provide hands-on hardware troubleshooting and support for NVIDIA-based AI/HPC infrastructure, including A100, H100, B200, B300, GB200 and GB300 platforms.

Key Responsibilities:
• Troubleshoot GPU servers, AI clusters, GPUs, CPUs, memory, system boards, NVLink/NVSwitch, NICs, DPUs, storage, power and cooling.
• Analyse BMC logs, NVIDIA Xid/ECC errors and hardware telemetry using NVIDIA SMI, DCGM, IPMI and OEM tools.
• Troubleshoot InfiniBand, Ethernet, RoCE, cables and transceivers.
• Perform hardware health checks, component replacement, testing and post-repair validation.
• Resolve BIOS, firmware, BMC, driver and hardware compatibility issues.
• Coordinate hardware replacements and escalations with OEMs/NVIDIA.
• Maintain incident records, troubleshooting guides and RCA reports.
• Support shift-based/on-call requirements when needed.

Required Skills:
• 3+ years of Data Centre, Server or HPC hardware support experience.
• Strong enterprise server and component-level troubleshooting skills.
• Knowledge of NVIDIA GPUs and multi-GPU systems.
• Working knowledge of Linux and server-management tools.
• Understanding of networking, storage, rack power and cooling.
• GPU/AI infrastructure experience is highly preferred.
• Strong troubleshooting, fault isolation and incident-management skills.

About The Company

Our client is a US-based software aggregator that leverages AI and machine learning to build scalable, intelligent solutions.

About The Role

Our client is seeking an AI / Machine Learning Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and deploying data-driven models into real-world applications. In this role, you will work on developing, training, and optimizing machine learning models, while collaborating closely with software engineers to integrate AI solutions into production systems.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning and AI models for real-world use cases.
• Work with structured and unstructured data to develop predictive, classification, or generative models.
• Develop and maintain data pipelines for data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
• Deploy machine learning models into production environments and monitor their performance.
• Optimize models for accuracy, scalability, and efficiency.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data) to translate business needs into AI solutions.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Warp, etc.) to improve development speed and code quality.

Qualifications

• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science roles.
• Excellent English communication skills.
• Strong proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or similar).
• Familiarity with deploying ML models in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional team.
• Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Warp) is a strong plus.
• Indonesian Citizen.

If you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment and are eager to work on impactful AI-driven products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
